What do we sell?

At HostHatch, we believe in keeping things simple.

We sell high performance cloud compute VMs, based on powerful AMD EPYC CPUs and high speed NVMe drives, available across the globe.

In addition, our storage VMs are designed for massive storage capacity, scalable up to hundreds of terabytes, making them a popular choice for cost-effective backups of your important data.

  • Compute VMs

    Available globally and constantly expanding. This is our flagship service. High performance compute VMs, with dedicated CPU allocations and extremely high IOPS NVMe disks. Deploy in 16 edge locations, and deliver consistently high-performance to your users, regardless of where they are located.
